mismatches; dirtyInputs() empty; skill digest matches).

DISPOSITION: escalate, on two grounds that the reviewer cannot and must not close itself.

(1) A mandatory command fails at the frozen commit. `npm run check:no-answer-keys` exits 1.
The single hit is NOT in Unit 4 and not in any bound input: it is
specs/content/efmp-302/reviews/unit-03/logs-run005/summary-run005.md, a Unit 3 review
artifact committed at 62257a3 itself, matched by /\banswer\s*key\b/. The gate scans
specs/content wholesale (scripts/check-no-answer-keys.mjs TARGETS) and excludes only
style-guide.md, so it reads review evidence as public content. Zero hits fall inside
docs/semester-1/efmp-302/unit-04/. Run 004 recorded this same command at exit 0, so the
condition is new and was introduced by the sibling Unit 3 review, not by Unit 4 authoring.
The evidence contract requires all seven named commands at exit 0 for a pass, so this alone
forecloses the pass path. It is a gate-scoping question for the owner/platform, not a Unit 4
repair, and the reviewer is forbidden from editing prior reports or repository content.

(2) One part of a carried uncertain finding is still open: three of ten RRQs sit below the
approved blueprint's Understand floor. Which artifact should move, the bank or the
blueprint, is an owner decision.

All four run-004 findings were judged independently. Three are resolved, one is partially
resolved; verdicts are recorded as individual findings below.

Assessment correctness is strong: all ten MCQ keys were derived blind from the prose before
the supplied key or any prior report was opened, and all ten agree (b, d, a, c, b, d, c, a,
b, c). Source support for both retrievable keys was checked passage by passage against the
bound excerpts. Accessibility was re-measured in a real browser at 1280x900, 360x780 and A4
print emulation.

findings.message:
NEW this run, and NOT a Unit 4 authoring defect. A mandatory command fails at the frozen commit.

`npm run check:no-answer-keys` exits 1 at HEAD 62257a3. Log:
specs/content/efmp-302/reviews/unit-04/logs-agent-g3-efmp302-u4-run005/check-no-answer-keys.log

The gate reports exactly one hit, and it is outside this unit and outside the bound input set:
  specs/content/efmp-302/reviews/unit-03/logs-run005/summary-run005.md
  matched /\banswer\s*key\b/
That file is a Unit 3 G3 review artifact added by commit 62257a3 itself. scripts/check-no-answer-keys.mjs
scans CONTENT_ROOTS plus i18n, build and specs/content (TARGETS, line 27) over .md/.mdx/.html, and its
only exclusion is specs/content/style-guide.md (line 54), so it treats committed review evidence as
public content. Zero hits fall inside docs/semester-1/efmp-302/unit-04/, verified by re-running the
gate and filtering for unit-04.

Why it is nonetheless blocking. The evidence contract requires all seven named commands at exit 0 for a
`pass` disposition, so this forecloses the pass path for Unit 4 mechanically, whatever the review finds
about the content. Run 004 recorded this same command at exit 0 (see its commands array), so the
condition was introduced between 70233c4 and 62257a3 by the sibling Unit 3 review, not by Unit 4 work.

This run added no hits of its own: every artifact it wrote is .log, .json, .mjs, .png or .pdf, and the
gate scans only .md/.mdx/.html. Re-run after writing all evidence still reports the same single hit.

OWNER / PLATFORM DECISION NEEDED. Either exclude reviews/ from the gate's traversal (it is already
excluded from the review input manifest, for the same reason), or reword the Unit 3 artifact. The
reviewer is forbidden from editing prior reports, repository content or gate scripts, so it cannot and
must not close this itself.
